column1: # Adaptyv/Anthropic Challenge 4 (TfR1 apical pH-switch binder) — v27 = v26 with 2 PHANTOM-COLLAPSE members replaced (2026-11-02)
# Trigger: red-team note ("new designs score ~2x a real binder -> suspect non-specific collapse; check WHERE they bind").

#   blind-Protenix run, cuequivariance ruler, n40=20 samples x seeds 101,102, human + mouse apical target). Then a 4-agent
#   adversarial workflow (3 skeptic lenses + conservative synthesis; pull only on 2/3 consensus with positive-control-surviving
#   evidence). Replacements vetted on the SAME calibrated ruler + novelty (ESMFold single-seq maxTM vs PDB) + JustHISpKa switch.
# (1) RED-TEAM WAS DIRECTIONALLY BACKWARDS: all 20 clear the only calibrated HUMAN binding signal iptm>=0.194
#     (in-run POS_3DS18 0.208-0.226 vs NEG_scramble 0.120-0.124; bootstrap scramble FPR ~0). The named high-iptm "suspects"
#     (rank11/17/8/12/2) are genuine binders; rank2 (w3g0_174) is the BEST cross-reactive binder (mouse be7/on_epi1.0/wepi0.265).
# (2) HUMAN EPITOPE-OVERLAP METRICS ARE NOISE: on the flat human apical epitope, POS_3DS18 wepi 0.100 < NEG_scramble floor 0.136
#     (scramble even posts higher best_epi/on_epi than POS). So wepi/best_epi/on_epi CANNOT condemn a member on human (fail the
#     positive control). A first-pass "wepi<scramble" gate falsely flagged 12/20 incl. POS-like members -> DISCARDED. On MOUSE the
#     metric IS calibrated-valid (POS wepi 0.120 > NEG 0.057), so specificity is adjudicated there.
# (3) TWO PHANTOM-COLLAPSE members (POS-valid, median-confirmed mouse signature = iptm>>mouse-POS AND on_epi<=0.2 AND best_epi 0
#     AND wepi<=floor, which POS does NOT trigger) — the only 2 of 20 firing it with median confirmation (rank1 fires on max only
